description: This Java class 'PreferenceServices' provides services for managing user preferences, including retrieving, setting, removing, copying preference groups, and handling preference data conversions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PreferenceServices
classes.description: A service class providing user preference management functionalities within OFBiz.

methods.name: getUserPreference
methods.description: Retrieves a single user preference based on type and optional group, returning preference data and value.

methods.name: getUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a group of user preferences, with fallback to general properties for defaults.

methods.name: setUserPreference
methods.description: Stores or updates a single user preference in persistent storage.

methods.name: removeUserPreference
methods.description: Removes a specific user preference from storage.

methods.name: setUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Stores a group of user preferences in persistent storage.

methods.name: copyUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Copies a preference group from one user to another.
